claims.evidence: PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; human breast cancer patient tissue, human-derived PDX and mammospheres. Mouse (NOG host) stroma is present in PDX but the sample under study is the human tumor; reconcile organism_contradicted BLOCKER is a prose-heuristic false positive (only 'mouse' appears in the protocol text as the host).
Title, description, PRIDE disease DOID:1612; protocol says ER-negative breast cancer patients. Applied to every row because every sample is tumor-derived (no control arm).
Breast cancer tumor tissue; PDX grown in mammary fat pad; mammospheres derived from PDX. Inferred as tissue of origin.

claims.evidence: Key xlsx maps 15 raw-file stems to manuscript IDs; raw stems name Primary / PDX / Mammosphere. Mammosphere M01->Mam12, M03->Mam03, M07->Mam18, M11->Mam11 exactly as in key.

claims.value: P02,P03,P05,P06,P08,P11,P12,P18 for Pri/PDX; not available for Mam
claims.evidence: P-number is part of the raw file stem for Primary and PDX. Mammosphere stems (M01..) carry no patient number; patient link not stated in accessible evidence. Reviewer suggested P03/P11/P12/P18 for Mam rows from key naming; refused: Mam12 comes from raw stem M01 (numbering does not follow stems) and the abstract states only that mammospheres derive from PDX tumors, not which patient.
Tumor tissue homogenised in urea buffer; mammospheres are enriched cell spheroids (single cell suspension, spin-filter prep).
No per-patient demographic in accessible PRIDE record; paper full text inaccessible. Sex deliberately not inferred from 'breast cancer'.

Protocol: 'analyzed in triplicate'. Mam12 (M01) raw files are _02,_03,_04 (no _01 deposited) and are numbered technical replicate 1-3 in deposit order. 45 .dat Mascot search files and the FASTA/key are not SDRF rows.
PRIDE instruments and decoded RAW header both Q Exactive; protocol says Easy-nLC 1000 + Q Exactive.
Protocol 'digested overnight with trypsin'; Mascot CLE=Trypsin.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Carbamyl K, Carbamyl N-term variable
claims.evidence: Mascot parameters: MODS=Carbamidomethyl (C); IT_MODS=Carbamyl (K),Carbamyl (N-term),Oxidation (M). Read from one sample's .dat only (P02Primary_01); assumed identical for all runs (same searching group/DB).
Shotgun label-free with Mascot MS/MS ion search (MIS) of peak lists; DDA is the standard mode but not literally stated in accessible text (inferred).
Description: 'label-free mass spectrometry'; PRIDE quantification spectrum counting.
Protocol says reduced and alkylated without naming the reduction reagent; dissociation not stated in accessible evidence.
Protocol: reduced and alkylated; Mascot fixed Carbamidomethyl (C); PRIDE PTM MOD:00397 iodoacetamide derivatized residue. Reagent inferred from these, not literally named in protocol text.

limitations: Publication full text (Cell Reports) could not be retrieved; sample-level clinical data (age, sex, grade, subtype beyond ER-negative) absent.
Mascot parameters read from a single .dat; the other 44 not individually inspected.
characteristics[phenotype] is used as a free-text carrier for sample class (primary tumor / PDX / mammosphere) because no licensed column fits; validator warns the terms are not in PATO/EFO.
Mammosphere-to-patient linkage not stated; individual left not available for Mam rows.
Data acquisition method DDA is inferred from the search setup, not stated.
